title: Robotic Design: Titan Rover J3 Wrist (Pitch & Roll)
description: Developed the J3 wrist to provide pitch and continuous roll for multi-axis manipulation (e.g., keyboards and joysticks). Integrated a 12-wire, 2A slip ring for infinite rotation, supported rotation with thrust bearings, and drove the joint with a NEMA 11 + 14:1 gearbox, iterating custom parts using both SLA (Form 2) and FDM (Ender 3 S1 Pro) printing.
skills: SLA 3D Printing with Engineering Strength Material
